Action.input_port: Robot state to request: IDLE, DRIVE, AIM, SHOOT or AUTO
Action.description: Ask the robot for a state. Instant, like a button press: succeeds at once. To wait for the state, retry IsSystemState

Condition.input_port: Robot state to check: IDLE, DRIVE, AIM, SHOOT or AUTO
Condition.description: The robot is in the given state right now (SUCCESS), or not (FAILURE)

Action.description: Drive a Choreo path until the end of it is reached
